D/ [IMP] C ALLECTVS P F AVG ; R/ [VIRTVS AVG or LAETITTIA AVG]

A worn and abraded Roman copper-alloy Q-Radiate of Allectus, (AD r.293-296 ) (Reece period 14). Obverse type: Radiate and cuirassed bearded bust right. Obverse legend: [IMP] C ALLECTVS P F AVG. Reverse type: unclear galley left. Reverse legend: [VIRTVS AVG or LAETITTIA AVG]. Mint unclear, London or C Mint.
